verdict.rationale: SerpApi is API-first: its UI 'playground' is described as an interactive demo of the same API endpoints, and its search engines, output formats (JSON/HTML/markdown), async submission and Searches Archive retrieval are all exposed as API parameters and endpoints. That makes the core search functionality fully reachable programmatically. Missing for 10: evidence that account and dashboard functions (plan settings like ZeroTrace or Automatic Early Renewal, usage, API key management) are available via API, any explicit statement of UI/API parity, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
